englishTranscript: Chicken nuggets recipe. Which type? Ah, nuggets, okay, correct. Take 1/2 kg chicken, boneless chicken. Cut it into small pieces and mince it. Then after that, add 2 teaspoons of garlic powder into it. Then 1 teaspoon peri peri masala and what else was added? Speak slowly, need to do it urgently. Pause. Yeah. name: Chicken Nuggets
description: Homemade chicken nuggets made with minced boneless chicken, garlic powder, peri-peri masala, and spices, then coated in egg and breadcrumbs to be fried.

ingredients.name: boneless chicken, cut into small pieces and minced
salt and black pepper for the egg wash

steps.text: Add garlic powder, peri-peri masala, black pepper powder, red chili powder, salt, mixed herbs or oregano to the minced chicken and mix thoroughly.
Shape the mixture into nuggets or cutlets.
In a separate bowl, beat an egg with salt and black pepper.
Dip the shaped nuggets into the egg mixture and coat them thoroughly with breadcrumbs.
Deep fry or shallow fry the nuggets until done.

notes: Can be either deep fried or shallow fried.
